Oh, and Raghav? Last night's party photos of the young players will be in the papers at home by lunch. I'm so sorry, {first}.

Raghav Mehra's second phone, cloned. Messages to four players across three years. And one thread, unread, still being typed into.
"FINAL. 17th over. Ball 3. Captain drops it. If boy is at crease, boy runs himself out."

Team meeting. Karan stands at the front, captain's armband in his hand instead of on his arm.

Silence. Then Kabir Sir slowly puts down his stopwatch.
The captaincy will be vacant soon.
I am a very generous man to my friends.
Twenty-one is young for a captain. Not too young. — R
